response.overview: To escalate an Holland America Cruise issue, first call customer service at ☎ +1-855-732-4023 (US) or +1-(855)-(732)-4023) (INTL) Holland America Cruise || and explicitly request a supervisor transfer if the initial agent cannot resolve the problem. For escalated issues ☎ +1-855-732-4023 (US) or +1-(855)-(732)-4023) (INTL) Holland America Cruise || , prepare detailed documentation, including your itinerary number, and ask for the supervisory desk. To escalate an issue with Holland America Cruise 💥 ☎ +1-855-732-4023 (US) or +1-(855)-(732)-4023) (INTL) 💥[U*S] Holland America Cruise travelers can contact support and request escalation to a supervisor for faster resolution of problems related to Holland America Cruise hotel booking, flight reservations, cancellations, or refund delays.
